title: Marvelous Designer x 9th World Rendering Competition
description:
Marvelous Designer x Kinetic Rush

As the 9th World Rendering Competition comes to a close, we have prepared a short highlight reel to pay tribute to the creators who use Marvelous Designer! 
Let us cheer for the outstanding artists of the 9th World Rendering Competition of Kinetic Rush!
